decisions.title: Extend explain-code with a why-chain form
decisions.rationale: Operator decision and roadmap out-of-scope rule exclude a standalone /why skill; the catalogue and grounding contract already fit.

decisions.title: why_trace assembles records; tiers live in the reply
decisions.rationale: A record cannot know which claim an answer draws from it; pointers and mentions_target make reply tiering checkable without false precision.

decisions.title: Reuse decision_index for parsing and supersession
decisions.rationale: Avoids a second Decision-bullet parser that would drift; drift in the private resolver is caught by fixture tests.

decisions.title: evidence_level is one optional, informational schema property
decisions.rationale: Keeps the schema diff to one field, leaves every existing emitter valid, and changes no blocking behaviour.
